checks.correctness: Whenever an unvisited land cell starts a flood, it belongs to a component not counted earlier. The flood visits exactly all land reachable by orthogonal steps in that component. checks.workedTrace: For ["1100","1001","0011"], cells in the upper-left form one connected island. The rightmost land in row 1 joins the two adjacent bottom-row land cells, forming a second island. The water between the two groups prevents a connection, so return 2.
checks.edgeCases: Diagonal contact does not connect islands. An all-water grid returns zero. The input grid is left unchanged while a separate visited structure records floods.
checks.timeDerivation: O(rows times columns) time. Every cell is scanned and each land cell is enqueued once; every dequeue checks four neighbors.
checks.spaceDerivation: O(rows times columns) auxiliary space. Visited marks and the flood queue are bounded by the number of grid cells.

Expected is serialized adjacency of the returned clone; the harness separately checks fresh nodes and preservation of the original graph.
